# temps_cron_monitor (Resource)

Alerts when a scheduled job stops checking in. Jobs check in with the Sentry-compatible cron API using `slug`; a monitor defined here makes Temps authoritative over the configuration jobs send.

Import with `<project_id>/<monitor_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `environments:read`, `environments:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_cron_monitor" "nightly_report" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  slug           = "nightly-report"
  schedule       = { crontab = "0 3 * * *" }
  timezone       = "Europe/Madrid"
  checkin_margin = 5
  max_runtime    = 60
}

resource "temps_cron_monitor" "sync" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  slug       = "inventory-sync"
  schedule   = { interval = 15, unit = "minute" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `schedule` (Attributes) When the job runs: set `crontab`, or `interval` with `unit`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `slug` (String) Identifier jobs check in with: 1 to 128 letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

### Optional

- `checkin_margin` (Number) Minutes a check-in may be late before it counts as missed, 1 to 40320. Defaults to 1.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether missed check-ins raise alarms. Defaults to `true`.
- `environment_id` (Number) Restrict the monitor to one environment of `project_id`. The same slug may exist once project-wide and once per environment.
- `failure_issue_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failures before an alarm opens, 1 to 100. Defaults to 1.
- `max_runtime` (Number) Minutes a run may take before it counts as failed, 1 to 40320. Defaults to 30.
- `recovery_threshold` (Number) Consecutive successes before the alarm resolves, 1 to 100. Defaults to 1.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone for `crontab`, for example `Europe/Madrid`. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric cron monitor ID.
- `status` (String) Last known status, for example `ok`, `missed` or `paused`.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Optional:

- `crontab` (String) Five-field crontab expression (minute hour day month weekday), for example `0 3 * * *`, evaluated in `timezone`.
- `interval` (Number) Run every `interval` `unit`s.
- `unit` (String) `minute`, `hour`, `day` or `week`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_cron_monitor.nightly_report 3/4
```
